content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bharathiar University Director Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application for the post of Director, Centre for Distance and Online Education. Submit it along with the Registration fee including Application fee for your category. Make sure the University receives the application and fee by the last date.

faq.question: Q1. Can a candidate who is already 57 apply?
faq.answer: No. The candidate must be below 57 years at the time of notification, and the notification is dated 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Can someone under 50 apply for this post?
faq.answer: No. The notification requires candidates to have completed 50 years at the time of notification.

faq.question: Q3. How much do OBC, SC and ST candidates pay?
faq.answer: Candidates in these categories pay Rs.300/-, which is half the Rs.600/- charged to the General category.

faq.question: Q4. Must the fee be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Yes. The filled in application must be received along with the Registration fee including Application fee.

faq.question: Q5. How is the Director's pay fixed?
faq.answer: The revised pay is listed as "As per their Primary Cadre", and the notification prints no separate amount.

faq.question: Q6. Who decides the qualification for the post?
faq.answer: The qualification is the one prescribed by the Syndicate of Bharathiar University.
